criteria.criterion: Administrators define profiles, field dictionaries, vocabularies, validation, and dynamic extensions without code changes.
criteria.evidence: Retained administrator-authored immutable field dictionaries, vocabularies, validation and typed extension profiles; published Studio Save and fresh-session reopen. No application code change is required to define a profile.

criteria.criterion: Metadata revisions preserve provenance, rights, lineage, multilingual values, and unmapped extensions.
criteria.evidence: Retained exact-revision profiles and metadata round trips preserve source/curated knowledge, rights, lineage, language-tagged values and unknown safe namespaces. Earlier real normal-owner multilingual persistence remains separately scoped.

criteria.criterion: GeoNode 5.1.0 metadata imports and exports with a field-level conversion report.
criteria.evidence: Published browser client with normal existing-owner authentication imports the private authored fixture in production and exports the pinned GeoNode5.1.0 contract with40field outcomes. Exact core metadata, source_fixture and source data custody compare equal. Reimport is idempotent with the same identity/version/metadata and retains the archived state; independent fresh read succeeds.

sourceDataCustody: _opengeo.metadataExtensions.geonode.data; explicitly reported as preserved_extension, not native GeoStory content conversion.
fixture: Original CC-BY-4.0 authored acceptance package in the pinned upstream shape; not a live GeoNode export. No restricted user data is copied.

usage.serviceMediatedKMS: Unknown; application request counts are not KMS counts.

retainedFailure: The initial live harness required top-level GeoStory data. The declared metadata profile preserves and reports that data in source custody. Canonical comparison and one targeted continuation pass; the original failure and all costs remain retained.
limits: This aggregation reruns no profile UI, API, database, source peer or standards validator. It reuses accepted producing profiles and does not assert fresh acceptance of every later changed implementation file.

ISO Schematron, a Records-specific executable ETS, production conformance declarations, complete ISO distribution/acquisition/locale mappings and saved/deployed QGIS clients are not required by these three original criteria; their prior incomplete status remains.
Unsupported source fields and locales remain exact source or explicit losses; no full GeoNode product migration, normative ISO/OGC conformance or arbitrary metadata-format completeness is claimed.

Local, production and source-peer environments remain distinct. This is supported metadata exchange, not full GeoNode publication/principal/binary/style migration, arbitrary metadata-format support or normative standards certification.
